label: PERF-MEMORY-004: remove silent importance=1.0 default + implement C2.1 batch skip
summary: Fixed two coupled bugs: (1) write path silently defaulted importance to 1.0 causing every episode to be falsely stamped user_override; (2) batch enricher never respected the user_override note, stripping genuinely user-asserted importance on every pass.

changes.kind: Removed importance=1.0 default (line 197→198), added computeImportance() call before INSERT (lines 312-333), pass userSuppliedImportance flag to enrichOnWrite (lines 442-443)
Added userSuppliedImportance?: boolean to EnrichOnWriteParams (line 65), changed userOverride check to respect the flag (lines 169-176)
Added C2.1 skip guard in processEpisode: parse enrich_ver.note and return early when 'user_override' (lines 325-332)
Added PERF-MEMORY-004 end-to-end write-path tests: no-explicit-importance computes content-derived score >1.0 without user_override note; explicit importance preserved with note
Added PERF-MEMORY-004 enrichOnWrite unit tests + C2.1 batch skip integration test
